video_title: OKC has some ‘tough decisions’ to make this offseason 👀 Is Chet in the future plans? | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder face significant luxury tax implications with upcoming contract extensions
quotes.excerpt: They are going to be deep into luxury tax with the extensions for Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams.
quotes.quote: We have to start with what is the financial pain threshold for Clay Bennett, the majority owner, and that ownership group. This is a team that has not paid luxury tax for the last six seasons, including obviously three years as a contender, one championship team. They are going to be deep into luxury tax with the extensions for Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams kicking in. They are going to vault into second apron territory. Now, Isaiah Hartenstein has a team option, Lou Dort has a team option. I am told it is extremely likely that Hartenstein is back, whether they pick up that option, whether they get an extension done with him. Obviously, going up against Victor Wembanyama likely every year now, you do not want to thin out your frontcourt depth.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren struggles against Victor Wembanyama's defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: It is not like Chet has an issue in the NBA, it is he has a Victor Wembanyama issue.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: It is obvious that this is a bad matchup. I know a lot of people were saying this is a rivalry right now, it looks like it is not, because Victor Wembanyama versus Chet Holmgren, we know it is more one-sided, especially when it comes to the NBA. But if you actually look at the numbers, Chet has done well versus all teams not named the San Antonio Spurs. It is not like Chet has an issue in the NBA, it is he has a Victor Wembanyama issue most specifically.

text_blocks.speaker: Danny Green
text_blocks.text: There is a difference Chet on the floor when you have a J-Dub, when you have AJ Mitchell, those guys open up the floor. But again, there is no excuse, so Chet has to do something for himself. He has to be in the gym, he has to be in the film session.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green reflects on his own playoff struggles and redemption
quotes.excerpt: I have been in series where I was unplayable against Oklahoma City Thunder in 2012.
quotes.quote: Everybody has had a nemesis in their life. Everybody has had a rivalry in their life and they beat up on you. He has a bad mismatch. You make it a better matchup by getting better and in the gym. So you go back to those film sessions. It is what I tell young kids all the time. The best way to learn is to get your behind bust and get better. So he had this as a failure, take this moments. I have been in series where I was unplayable against Oklahoma City Thunder in 2012. I was a starter. If I did not take shots, Pop was like, I cannot play you. So I was able, I was benched then at that point. I took that summer, said I am never going to let this happen to me again. 2013, the rest is history.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby is the Knicks' most effective defender against Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: OG Anunoby is actually their best defender, no surprise here, on Victor Wembanyama.
quotes.quote: OG Anunoby is actually their best defender, no surprise here, on Victor Wembanyama. If you crunch the numbers, look, he limits him to the fewest amount of points relative to Karl-Anthony Towns who is trying, but everybody else, it is like popcorn season, that is barbecue chicken. 73 points per 100 matchups. You want to keep OG Anunoby on him. Why? I will show you, because he has a good combination. He may not have the 7-5 height, but he has physicality, he is strong, and he can beat him to spots. Good help side from Josh Hart, who is a heart and soul guy.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Regular season performance does not predict playoff series outcomes
quotes.excerpt: We have seen that last series to me, it showed it did not matter at all.
quotes.quote: We have seen that last series to me, it showed it did not matter at all. Because if it did, in that Oklahoma City-San Antonio series, the Spurs would have swept the Thunder, or they won 4-1. But because the playoffs is so much more different and teams that have been there experience matters, that Oklahoma City series was decided in a Game 7 without some guys missing and some stars. They still had a chance to win. This Spurs team is a different Spurs team. They have grown. Wembanyama is grown. He is seen the double big-big matchup before. Stefan Castle is grown. He is guarded Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, a two-time MVP. Now he has to guard Jalen Brunson. So they are not saying this is like a walk in the park, but they had a heavy hitting fight, they are battle tested and they are ready.
